tests.name: cargo fmt --all --check
tests.detail: Exit code 0, no output (no formatting diffs).

tests.name: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings
tests.detail: Executed as the equivalent form 'cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings' (exit 0). On cargo/rustc 1.98.1 the literal form without '--' is rejected: 'error: unexpected argument -D found' (verified, exit 1), so the '--' separator is required to pass -D warnings through to clippy. Only output was a manifest warning ('unused manifest key: alias' in root Cargo.toml — cargo 1.98 honours [alias] only from .cargo/config.toml, where it is also declared); this is not a lint and does not fail -D warnings.

tests.name: deliverable: workspace Cargo.toml with the 5 crates
tests.detail: Root Cargo.toml declares [workspace] resolver=2, members = crates/{z80, galaxian-core, galaxian-audio, galaxian-frontend, xtask}; workspace.package edition='2021' (cargo metadata confirms all 5 packages resolve to edition 2021); allowed deps bitflags/thiserror declared in [workspace.dependencies] but unused by any member yet; no dependencies added beyond Partie C.

tests.name: deliverable: crate lint attributes
tests.detail: All 5 crates declare [lints.clippy] all='deny' + pedantic='warn'. z80, galaxian-core and galaxian-audio each declare [lints.rust] unsafe_code='forbid' in their Cargo.toml (z80 additionally has #![no_std] in lib.rs; core/audio/frontend/xtask have #![forbid(unsafe_code)] in source as well). Lints are per-crate rather than workspace-level because cargo 1.98 rejects mixing lints.workspace=true with a per-crate [lints.rust] table (documented in root Cargo.toml comment); the required attributes are present on each crate's manifest as specified.

tests.name: deliverable: minimal compilable crates
tests.detail: z80 lib.rs (#![no_std], pub mod alu/regs/timing), galaxian-core (pub mod memory/timing), galaxian-audio (pub mod synth) are module skeletons only (~60-76 byte stub modules); galaxian-frontend is a dependency-free lib; xtask is a bin crate. All compile under the workspace build.

tests.name: deliverable: cargo xtask alias + api-dump
tests.detail: [alias] xtask = 'run --package xtask --' present in root Cargo.toml and repeated in .cargo/config.toml (required for functionality on cargo 1.98). 'cargo xtask api-dump' exits 0 and prints public signatures per crate: z80 -> pub mod alu/regs/timing; galaxian-core -> pub mod memory/timing; galaxian-audio -> pub mod synth; galaxian-frontend and xtask listed with no public items. run-zex, mame-diff, test-roms, golden each print 'not implemented yet' and exit 0.

tests.name: deliverable: CI workflow
tests.detail: .github/workflows/ci.yml present; triggers on push and pull_request to main (ubuntu-latest, stable toolchain + clippy/rustfmt); runs the three commands in order: 'cargo fmt --all --check', 'cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings' (the form valid on cargo 1.98), 'cargo test --workspace'.

tests.name: deliverable: versioned empty dirs + roms gitignore
tests.detail: tests/roms/.gitkeep, tests/golden/.gitkeep, tests/third_party/.gitkeep and roms/.gitkeep all exist on disk; git check-ignore confirms none of them are ignored (they will be versioned). .gitignore excludes target/, roms/* with !roms/.gitkeep exception (verified: a hypothetical roms/some_commercial.rom is IGNORED while roms/.gitkeep is not), plus editor/OS cruft.

notes: No trace/frame comparison applies to this task (no code yet); first_divergence is null.

Codeur's claim that all commands pass is confirmed by independent execution; the only caveat is the clippy invocation form: on cargo 1.98.1 'cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings' without '--' fails with 'unexpected argument -D found', so the equivalent '... -- -D warnings' was used (also what ci.yml uses).

The root Cargo.toml [alias] table emits a harmless manifest warning on cargo 1.98 ('unused manifest key: alias'); it does not affect any validation command's exit code and is required by the task spec, with .cargo/config.toml carrying the functional copy.
